potionNumbersLabel: Show the number a potion found
potionNumbersHelp: Hover a potion’s result in the bulk-roll potion table and the number its best roll ended up as is added right after the EP. Works for variant potions and badge potions.
potionNumbersFine: Only changes the hover text on your screen, right away. Nothing is sent to the game. If the game hides a number (a sealed bulk roll), there is nothing to add.
